title: Slow Convergence of Ising and Spin Glass Models with Well-Separated Frustrated Vertices
summary: The ferromagnetic Ising model on an $n\times n$ square lattice region $Λ$ with mixed boundary conditions can exhibit a phase transition as temperature varies. For this spin system, if we fix the spins on the top and bottom sides of the square to be $+$ and the left and right sides to be~$-$, a standard Peierls argument based on energy shows that below some critical temperature~$t_c$, any local Markov chain $\mathcal{M}$ requires time exponential in $n$ to mix.
